The negative side is instead about coalition bargaining, ally-sharing, and cabinet delays, not overt nepotism.","evidence":[{"title":"DR Congo president names planning minister as new PM","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-04-01","url":"https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/dr-congo-president-appoints-countrys-first-female-prime-minister-2024-04-01/","summary":"Tshisekedi named Judith Suminwa, then planning minister, as prime minister. Reuters said the move ended weeks of uncertainty and followed a search for a parliamentary majority coalition. This is positive evidence that he elevated a policy-oriented economic official into the top executive role.","question_ids":["5B.2","4B.10","4B.7"]},{"title":"Biographie de la Première Ministre","publisher":"Primature","date":"2024","url":"https://www.primature.gouv.cd/biographie-de-la-premiere-ministre/","summary":"The prime minister’s own biography says Suminwa had a master’s in applied economics, banking experience, UN/PNUD experience, work at the budget ministry, and leadership on the 145 Territories development program and the 2024-2028 development plan. That is strong evidence of a competent economic professional, not a mere loyalist.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"Profil Min - Ministre des Finances","publisher":"Administration des Finances","date":"2024","url":"https://adminfinances.cd/ProfilMin.php","summary":"The finance ministry profile says Doudou Fwamba had economics and public-finance credentials and more than ten years in the finance administration, rising through the ministry before becoming minister. This is strong evidence for merit-based appointment of a career economic bureaucrat.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"IMF Executive Board Concludes the 2024 Article IV Consultation...","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-07-03","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/07/03/pr24253-drc-imf-exec-board-concludes-2024-art-iv-consult-completes-6th-rev-ecf-arr","summary":"The IMF said the authorities maintained prudent macroeconomic policies, avoided monetary financing, and made progress on domestic revenue mobilization, while the BCC kept a tight monetary stance. The same release says reforms were moving slowly, which makes this evidence positive but limited: the economic team was real and active, but not yet transformative.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]},{"title":"IMF Reaches Staff-Level Agreement with the Democratic Republic of Congo on An Extended Credit Facility and A Resilience and Sustainability Facility","publisher":"IMF","date":"2024-11-13","url":"https://www.imf.org/en/news/articles/2024/11/13/pr-24416-drc-imf-reaches-agreement-on-ecf-and-rsf","summary":"The IMF said the new program aimed at inclusive growth, diversification, job creation, better governance, and poverty reduction, and it explicitly called for stronger treasury procedures, spending-chain discipline, and decentralizing spending authorization to line ministries. That suggests economic professionals were being given a real reform mandate, though still under close central control.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1","4B.4"]},{"title":"DR Congo names new government after months of delay","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-28","url":"https://www.marketscreener.com/news/latest/DR-Congo-names-new-government-after-months-of-delay-46846207/","summary":"Reuters reported that internal jostling for jobs delayed the cabinet for months, and that the new government remained larger than expected despite pressure to cut costs. This is negative evidence that political bargaining still shaped appointments more than technocratic streamlining.","question_ids":["5B.2","4B.5","4B.8"]},{"title":"DRC parliament elects ally as speaker","publisher":"Reuters","date":"2024-05-23","url":"https://www.theprint.in/world/drc-parliament-elects-thishekedi-ally-as-speaker-/7623172/","summary":"Reuters described Vital Kamerhe as a close ally of Tshisekedi and a former chief of staff and economy deputy PM; his elevation to speaker helped clear the way for government formation. This is evidence that political loyalty and coalition management remained central to the power structure, even around economically relevant state formation.","question_ids":["5B.2","4B.5","4B.8"]},{"title":"Deux Nouveaux programmes avec le FMI : Aimé BOJI et Doudou Fwamba étaient devant la presse","publisher":"Ministère du Budget","date":"2024-11-15","url":"https://budget.gouv.cd/deux-nouveaux-programmes-avec-le-fmi-aime-boji-et-doudou-fwamba-etaient-devant-la-presse/","summary":"The budget ministry said the finance and budget ministers jointly presented the new IMF programs and credited reforms since June 2024 to improved coordination between those ministries. This is limited but real evidence that the economic team was empowered to negotiate and execute reforms, not just serve as passive figureheads.","question_ids":["5B.2","5B.1"]}]}
